newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA TO ISSUE 328.65 BLN LEI IN SIX-MONTH BILLS.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA TO ISSUE 328.65 BLN LEI IN SIX-MONTH BILLS.

text.p: Romania's Finance Ministry said on Wednesday it would launch 328.65 billion lei worth of six-month discount treasury bills on August 15.
The T-bills with a face value of 10 million lei are offered through a single-price auction on August 13 with investors allowed to submit only competitive bids.

Seeking to consolidate internal debt, the Finance Ministry has sold its first six-month papers in a year this week. The issue of 512.99 billion lei was slightly oversubscribed at Tuesday's auction when the yield was set at 44.01 percent.
Another issue of 659.03 billion lei in 182-day T-bills was previously announced for August 14. The auction will be held two days before the issue date.
The T-bills are available for commercial banks operating in Romania and their Romanian resident corporate clients. The ministry can decide to increase the issue in case of oversubscription.
